recommendations.name: JITLine (replication package)
recommendations.description: Research code that predicts defect-introducing commits and the risky lines inside them, reported as far faster than deep-learning approaches, though it is a notebook-based replication package rather than a polished tool and shows no license.

recommendations.name: ISSTA21-JIT-DP (LApredict, DeepJIT, CC2Vec, LR-JIT baselines)
recommendations.description: MIT-licensed artifact with git-mining data extraction scripts plus a simple lines-added baseline (LApredict) that the authors report beats DeepJIT and CC2Vec, making it the most practical starting point for flagging risky commits.

recommendations.name: DeepJIT
recommendations.description: CNN-based end-to-end just-in-time defect prediction model with train and predict commands, but it is research code with old pinned dependencies and no stated license.
